# React release recovery (disabled proposal)

This is not an active publishing path. Enablement requires separate authorization, verified immutable protected tag rules (including no update, deletion or bypass), approved first-parent history on `main`, reviewed standalone authority transition, a correctly scoped npm trusted publisher for `martletdesign/react`, `tag-release.yml`, environment `react-production-release`, and working immutable documentation archival and delivery. Keep the existing workbench authority and registry configuration unchanged pending that handoff. The protected tag is the routine authorization; do not add a per-release reviewer. The environment sentinel must exist only in the protected environment, without repository or organization fallback. It is not evidence of protection.

If npm publication succeeds but a later step fails, do not rerun publication: the preflight rejects existing versions. Reproduce the exact isolated archive from the unchanged protected tag, verify the remote tag and first-parent source commit, and run `RELEASE_TAG=vX.Y.Z node scripts/tag-release-cli.mjs verify-registry /absolute/path/to/reproduced.tgz`. Independently install the exact version in an empty consumer and run `npm audit signatures --json --include-attestations > audit.json`; only if that command succeeds, set `RELEASE_TAG` and `GITHUB_SHA` to the verified tag and commit and run `node scripts/tag-release-cli.mjs verify-provenance audit.json /absolute/path/to/reproduced.tgz`. Verify every byte, integrity value, provenance identity and documentation archive before separately reconciling the GitHub Release for that tag. If any check fails or its result is unavailable, stop and investigate; never republish or move the tag.

The registry can be temporarily unavailable or staged versions can exist outside public metadata; uncertainty and conflicting reservations fail closed. Actual OIDC publication and GitHub Release recovery have not been exercised.
